name: AlphaCOGANT: Recursive Corporate Self-Improvement as Active Inference
description: An illustrative reduced Active Inference model inspired by the AlphaFund recursive-self-improvement whitepaper: five capital channels become hidden-state factors in a fixed generative model, allocation minimizes one-step Expected Free Energy, and t-RSI separately summarizes paired synthetic create-minus-decay samples. Manuscript model numerics are generated by the NumPy engine; no live financial performance or enforced improvement gate is claimed.
